notes.title: The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark - Nintendo Switch / PS5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey detectives, 

We have released a patch for Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark that fixed some hotspot inconsistencies and placements which could interfere with the players’ inventory, fixed an issue with some achievements not firing, and more. You can read the full patch notes below.

Patch Notes

 Fixed an issue with some achievements not firing
 Fixed some hotspots inconsistencies and placements which could interfere with the players’ inventory
 Fixed some dialogue errors and typos
 Fixed some visual and sfx glitches which would appear after a save/load
 Fixed an issue where resetting the game caused the Power Button to show in the the Main Menu on Consoles
 Optimisation and improvements to performance and load times
 Fixed some gameplay blockers where players where unable to progress past certain screens
 Fixed issues with remapping controls
 Added some missing localisation
 Fixed issue with the Face Buttons not showing on the PlayStation How to Play Screen
 Fixed issues with Restarting a Case taking you to the wrong Case
 Fixed issues with dialogue Choices not saving
 Fixed other issues with starting the game from a fresh Save
 Fixed the slower cursor slower in Case 9
 Fixed not being able to use the Pause Menu in the Christmas Case
 Minor bug fixes


- Riv Otter

notes.title: Play "One Flew Into the Cuckoo's Nest" Today!
notes.content:
Hey, Detectives! 

New Case

Welcome to another case for McQueen and Dooley in the quaint little city of Twin Lakes. This time, our intrepid detectives find a note saying they should head to the Twin Lakes Botanical Gardens. What could possibly be in store? Vegetarian werewolves? A mean, green mother from inner space? A space ghost on a trip coast to coast? 

None of those things! 

But if you want more information, you'll have to play a little Darkside Detective to figure them out! 

Chinese Localization

Today's update also adds Chinese localization for the Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark! We've gotten A TON of feedback from chinese players that they'd love to play the game in their native language, so we're very happy to oblige them! 

Nigel Makeship Plush

Alongside the release of the new case, we're also debuting the Nigel Makeship plush! Makeship is a crowdfunding site where you can pick up your very own Nigel the conspiracy theorist lake monster plush! The campaign isn't live right this second but we are running a giveaway on Twitter if you're quick!

Here's how the campaign will work:

1) The campaign runs for three weeks!
2) Once we get 200 orders, the plushes get made!
3) Orders are only open during the campaign and can't be placed once it completes, so get them now!

The Nigel plush comes with a copy of the first game free, so if you're itching to find a way to introduce your friends to Darkside Detective, this is a spectacular opportunity. 

Buddy Gets Good: Nigel Makeship Stream and Q&A

And if you want to have a little fun with the Makeship campaign and Nigel plush, come hang out in the Akupara Games Discord on Monday, April 18th! I'll be streaming two Darkside Detective cases to the Discord and hosting a Q&A session with the folks at Makeship at 4PM Pacific/7PM Eastern! 

If you wanna learn how the Darkside Detective Twitter Adventure would end up becoming One Flew Into the Cuckoo's Nest, we'll be answering that and other questions! 

Exciting times to be a Darkside Detective fan! We've got one more bonus case on the docket, so look out for it in the not-too-distant future. 

Happy hunting!
-Buddy

notes.title: Play The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark Right Now!
notes.content:
Hello again, Detectives!

It's finally here! You can play The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark right here, right now. Picking up after the events of the first game's final case, A Fumble in the Dark answers all the important questions that have been on all of our minds!


What's McQueen been doing since Dooley's gone?
What's Dooley's grandma like?
How on Earth is there a castle full of Dooleys in Ireland?
What clown would think it's cool to name himself after a viral rash?
If Dooley was a luchador, what might that luchador be like?
What were Dooley and McQueen like in high school?


If any of these questions haven't been on your minds, well, the game's still fun. Featuring six new cases, a brand new soundtrack (that's also for sale) and all the pointing and clicking that your index finger can tolerate.
